summary: Implemented email delivery to multiple recipients with subscription management and unsubscribe handling. Added dedicated Kiro subscriber storage with per-subscriber unsubscribe tokens. Created a server-side API endpoint (api/send-kiro-newsletter.js) that sends individualized emails through Resend or SendGrid, each containing a personalized unsubscribe link. Created an unsubscribe API endpoint (api/unsubscribe.js) that renders a confirmation page and records the opt-out. Updated the HTML digest template footer to include unsubscribe links. Updated compileAndDeliver to route Kiro subscribers through the API with per-recipient HTML, while preserving legacy mailto/SMS fallback. Added a new 'subscribers' tab to the KiroUpdates UI for managing Kiro newsletter subscribers and configuring email delivery settings.
